messages:
incident-bot: Pager — metering pipeline: ingest lag > 12m and token ledger delta mismatch. Several orgs receiving overage flags. Auto-escalating to oncall.
alice (oncall): ack — I'm oncall. pulling billing/devin and SRE. starting triage.
devin (billing): looking now — I see emitter consumer lag on agg-node-2, last successful commit at 2026-03-10T11:48Z. offsets growing.
sre-kate: any customer-facing impact known? mike-cs can you confirm?
mike-cs: two customers pinged support about overage emails; no charges posted yet. i'll prepare holding message.
alice (oncall): mitigation step 1: pause alerting that generates overage emails so we don't spam customers while we reconcile. running toggle now.
alice (oncall): `/bin/ops toggle-flag billing.alerting.overage_emails --state paused --reason "mitigation - emitter lag"`
incident-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-ingest-lag.md
devin (billing): root cause looks like a Kafka rebalance triggered a consumer timeout on partition 4; commit failures shown in the emitter logs. planning restart of emitter consumer and backfill of missing window.
zach-eng: restarting emitter consumer on agg-node-2: `systemctl restart redwood-emitter.service` — tailing logs now.
zach-eng: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-10T11:49:02Z ERROR commit failed Partition 4 Timeout
2026-03-10T11:49:12Z INFO redwood-emitter.service: started
2026-03-10T11:49:18Z INFO consumer rejoined group, offset 14567234
```
devin (billing): consumer restart succeeded. kicking off backfill for 11:48Z->12:05Z window to reconcile emitted deltas. command:
```
python tools/backfill_tokens.py --from 2026-03-10T11:48Z --to 2026-03-10T12:05Z --target agg-node-2
```
alice (oncall): monitoring reconciliation. I've kept alerting paused for 30m to avoid churn. will update in 15m.
sre-kate: can we confirm whether ledger KV keys were preserved across the rebalance? eva-prod can you sanity-check redis?
eva-prod: quick KV check: `redis-cli --db 6 --scan | grep ledger:agg-node-2` shows offset keys present and TTLs normal. no obvious eviction.
devin (billing): backfill running. ETA ~10-15m depending on window. once completed we'll re-evaluate flags and retract any false positives.
mike-cs: holding outbound customer comms. i'll message affected orgs: "We're investigating billing alert emails; no charges processed while we reconcile"
alice (oncall): update: emitter backfill progressed to 60% — token delta reconciliation in flight. will post another update on completion.
devin (billing): backfill finished at 5143213300 — reconciled ~98% of deltas automatically. two orgs had edge-case mismatches due to duplicated mini-batches; running targeted reconcile for those.
alice (oncall): re-evaluating overage notifications. plan: keep alerts suppressed for an extra 10m, then re-enable and monitor for churn.
devin (billing): final reconcile job ran and fixed the two edge-case orgs. ledger deltas now match expected emit counts. overage flags cleared and any queued notifications dropped (no charges issued).
mike-cs: confirmed with both customers — they saw removal of the flagged alert, no billing impact. sending post-incident note.
sre-kate: marking system stable; will watch for jitter on consumer group for 1h.
alice (oncall): summary: cause = Kafka partition rebalance -> emitter consumer commit failures -> emitter lag -> false overage flags. mitigation = pause overage notifications, restart consumer, backfill deltas, targeted reconcile. customer impact = transient alert emails for 2 orgs, no charges. owners: Billing (devin), SRE (kate), Eng (zach). next: postmortem and durable fix (consumer commit retries + rebalance guard).
incident-bot: Incident resolved for paging window.
alice (oncall): thanks everyone, great quick work :thumbsup: — closing thread and creating postmortem ticket.
